description: Asks how expressions behave inside action queries on a writable copy: INSERT ... SELECT with Format over Mx, UPDATE SET with Replace and with Left/Len under a WHERE function, INSERT ... SELECT with CInt over text that does not convert (and the same over convertible rows), UPDATE with a division by zero on every row and on one row, UPDATE and DELETE with an unknown function, INSERT with a refused-name candidate (Environ), INSERT VALUES with function calls, DELETE under a function predicate, and UPDATE setting Null. After each statement the RecordsAffected and every row of the scratch table W are read, so partial effects and the statement's atomicity are visible. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE W (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_W PRIMARY KEY, V TEXT(100))
INSERT INTO W (ID, V) SELECT ID, Format(D, '0.00') FROM Mx
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
UPDATE W SET V = Replace(V, '.', ',')
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
UPDATE W SET V = Left(V, 2) & '|' & Len(V) WHERE Len(V) > 3
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
INSERT INTO W (ID, V) SELECT ID + 100, CStr(CInt(T)) FROM Mx
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
INSERT INTO W (ID, V) SELECT ID + 200, CStr(CInt(T)) FROM Mx WHERE ID IN (1, 5)
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
UPDATE W SET V = CStr(1 / (ID - ID))
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
UPDATE W SET V = CStr(1 / (ID - 1))
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
UPDATE W SET V = NoSuchFunc(V)
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
INSERT INTO W (ID, V) SELECT ID + 300, Environ('R_EXPR_1B_NOVAR') FROM Mx WHERE ID = 1
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
INSERT INTO W (ID, V) VALUES (500, UCase('x') & Format(5, '000'))
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
DELETE FROM W WHERE Len(V) > 3
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
DELETE FROM W WHERE NoSuchFunc(ID) = 1
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
UPDATE W SET V = Null WHERE IsNull(V) = False AND ID < 10
SELECT ID, V FROM W ORDER BY ID
